subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu streaming card full-content updates cause severe latency regression on long replies

question: Should Feishu streaming cards remain full-content-only with a stronger coalescing/backpressure fix, or should OpenClaw add an explicit append/delta escape hatch for deployments where full-content CardKit updates are too slow?
rationale: Current repository policy has a high bar for new config surfaces, but the newest live repro says the no-new-config cadence approach did not materially fix the user-visible latency.

options.title: Require proof before a new mode
options.body: Keep full-content as the default and require exact-head live Feishu evidence that coalescing/backpressure cannot solve the latency before adding an append/delta mode.

options.title: Accept an opt-in append mode
options.body: Add a documented opt-in append/delta mode with truncation regression coverage and live proof that affected deployments recover latency without breaking final content.

options.title: Pause the linked PR
options.body: Hold or close the cadence-only PR until maintainers choose the payload-mode direction and a contributor can provide live Feishu evidence.

recommendation.title: Require proof before a new mode
recommendation.body: Keep full-content as the default and require exact-head live Feishu evidence that coalescing/backpressure cannot solve the latency before adding an append/delta mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata marks this handle as the Feishu plugin owner, and the decision is plugin-local Feishu CardKit behavior.
